profile.name: UDP组播CAN虚拟总线
profile.description: 用于实验软件中的非物理虚拟通信组件，通过 IP/UDP 组播在多个进程或主机之间传输 CAN 或 CAN-FD 报文。适合局域网内的分布式测试、仿真和进程间总线消息交换，不对应具体硬件仪器。
profile.description_en: A non-physical virtual communication component used in lab software to exchange CAN or CAN-FD messages between multiple processes or hosts over IP/UDP multicast. It is suited for distributed testing, simulation, and inter-process bus messaging on a LAN, and does not correspond to a specific hardware instrument.

registry.name: Open Standard UDP Multicast Bus
registry.description: UDP Multicast BUS是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备。支持Signal, Slot, fileno等操作。
